term: joint two-root interpretation of necessary existence, represented simplicity and individuation
definition: NecessarySimplePlurality fixes four beings (left, right, instrument, effect), two universally accessible worlds and three represented respects (esse, drive, heat). Strict rank increase gives components, priority and world-local cause/support. Both roots drive an instrument, which moves an effect in a different respect. The same essence, esse, act and candidate functions instantiate the existing q3/Q11 interfaces. Simplicity and pure act are derived through existing theorems; no Simple or God flag is added.
note: A finite formal control for #320, not a full Thomistic ontology. Intrinsic-tagged PSR reasons remain weak assignments; material/proper-component simplicity and the existing matter/form/essence–esse inclusion do not establish genus–difference, subject–accident or unrestricted metaphysical simplicity. The roots are candidates, not identified Gods.
